column1: # Miri-excepted tests (`#[cfg_attr(miri|all(miri,..)|any(miri,..), ignore...)]`) that cannot run
# under G-ASAN / G-LSAN on a given host OS. Read by san_miri_crosscheck.py; see its header.
# Columns (TAB-separated): OS (`uname -s`, or * for every OS), crate, a glob over
# "<module path>::<fn>" (the module path is derived from the file, inline `mod`s excluded),
# and the reason. A row that matches nothing, or whose tests ran and passed, is stale (RED).
